title: Reject an empty repository-relative path
prompt: In this CodeIndex repository, make normalizeRelativePath in src/core/query/querySupport.ts reject an empty path with a CodeIndexError whose code is invalid_argument, and add a test in test/querySupport.test.ts that asserts the empty path is rejected with that code. Do not modify any other file. List every file you changed under src/ or test/ and nothing else.
